2.9.2 Model Aspect
In the model-perspective, the software architecture looks like shown in Figure 2.26. Guide to BSW Distribution Figure 2.26: Model perspective on multi-partition service modules The service BSW component provides individual Service SWC description types- and prototypes per ECU partition. Each of these component types provides the full set of service interfaces according to the current configuration of the component. It is recommended to add name-suffixes to the component type- and prototypes which show the partition assignment and thus help during integration. Rationale for providing individual types is the AUTOSAR constraint that all prototypes of a component type must be mapped to the same ECUC partition. The service interfaces are fully compatible. It shall be transparent to the SWC and the RTE on which partition they connect to a BSW service.
